title: Reduction at the record boundary
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a partial state reduction on the phase-dependent state type. In the false-parameter case, a record state carrying a position equal to the record width $4k+4$ is sent to the true-parameter state type with tag phase; all other states, including the absent record state, are sent to no value. In the true-parameter case, every state is sent to no value.
